scope: Cross official OpenWrt releases and router models for the recently changed PIN-related path; read-only compatibility audit, not full-product or radio certification.
definition: Compatibility includes exact release, installed components, target/subtarget, package architecture, network structure, radio capability, and actual firmware identity.

rounds.focus: Exact system release and dependency source
rounds.correction: Previous series-branch HEAD sources alone did not prove all minor releases. These records pin each release packages feed commit.

findings: AX3600 changes target from ipq807x/generic in reviewed 23.05 to qualcommax/ipq807x in reviewed 24.10 and 25.12.
CPU architecture agreement alone does not identify a model or certify wireless features.
JCG Q30 actual firmware remains unconfirmed; Q30 Pro evidence must not be applied to Q30.
rounds.limitation: Boundary versions only, not every model/minor-release combination. Missing profiles.json is not itself proof the firmware does not exist.

rounds.finding: No new deterministic code compatibility defect established in the reviewed shared identity/package selection paths. Dependency command availability does not certify wireless operation.

unresolved: The supplied feedback does not establish the cause of all missing replies.
No cross-model live PIN acceptance or full driver/firmware certification performed.
Other supported models beyond the five and intermediate model versions were not re-fetched in round two.
Not all native driver combinations were inspected or tested.
result: Three documentation/code review rounds completed with the stated coverage. This does not establish that PIN failures are fixed or that every supported combination works.
